backup.missingFolders: These folders could not be read, so any numbers here would be wrong:
backup.tilesFailed: The comparison finished, but the wallpaper details could not be read:
backup.acfUnreadable: Steam's workshop file could not be read, so no Workshop wallpaper can be reported as out of date.
backup.reconcileAbout: These names sit in more than one library or backup, so there is no single answer to whether they are backed up. Open a pair and decide which copy to keep.

integrity.title: Integrity check
integrity.about: Scans every wallpaper folder in your libraries and backups. Checks whether Wallpaper Engine can load them. Detected issues appear below.
integrity.clean: No problems found in the scanned folders.

advice.packedSceneNoProject: These folders contain packed wallpapers but no project.json. Wallpaper Engine cannot see them. Resolve extracts them as projects.
advice.unpackedSceneNoProject: These folders contain scene.json but no project.json. Wallpaper Engine cannot see them. Resolve creates the missing project.json.
advice.mediaOnly: These folders contain images or videos but no wallpaper project. Resolve can create one or move the folder to the Recycle Bin.
advice.payloadMissing: Each project is missing the file shown below. Resolve restores it from the same wallpaper in the paired library or backup.
advice.projectUnreadable: Wallpaper Engine cannot read project.json in these folders. Resolve replaces it from the same wallpaper in the paired library or backup.
advice.shaderCacheOnly: These folders contain only shader cache left after Workshop wallpapers were removed. They are safe to delete.

integrity.resolvedAdvice: Resolved during this app session. This list clears when the app closes.

fix.title: Resolve folder?
fix.rescueOne: Extract {name}, then move its source folder to the Recycle Bin? If extraction fails, the source stays in place.
fix.rescueMany: Extract {count} wallpapers? Each source folder moves to the Recycle Bin only after its extraction succeeds.
fix.writeOne: Create project.json for scene.json, using {name} as the title? No other files will change.
fix.writeMany: Create project.json in {count} folders for scene.json, using each folder name as its title? No other files will change.
fix.restoreOne: Restore the missing file from its healthy matching wallpaper?
fix.restoreMany: Restore missing files in these {count} folders from their healthy matching wallpapers?
fix.replaceOne: Replace the damaged project.json with its healthy matching copy?
fix.replaceMany: Replace damaged project.json files in these {count} folders with their healthy matching copies?
fix.mediaChoiceOne: Choose how to resolve this folder. Creating a project requires one image or MP4.
fix.mediaChoiceMany: Choose how to resolve these {count} folders. Each project requires one image or MP4.
fix.mediaCreateOne: Create a Wallpaper Engine project? The media file will not change.
fix.mediaCreateMany: Create Wallpaper Engine projects in these {count} folders? Their media files will not change.
fix.mediaRecycleOne: Move this folder to the Recycle Bin?
fix.mediaRecycleMany: Move these {count} folders to the Recycle Bin?
fix.cacheOne: This folder contains only shader cache. Move it to the Recycle Bin?
fix.cacheMany: These {count} folders contain only shader cache. Move them to the Recycle Bin?
fix.noLibrary: Choose a myprojects library in Settings. The wallpaper will be extracted there.
fix.noTool: Choose the RePKG path in Settings.
fix.noScene: scene.json is missing. No files were changed.
fix.noPkg: scene.pkg is no longer in this folder.
fix.alreadyThere: project.json already exists in this folder.
fix.unreadable: This folder could not be read.
fix.cacheChanged: This folder now contains other files, so it was not moved. Scan again.
fix.trashUnconfirmed: Windows could not confirm the move. The folder remains in its original location.
fix.noCounterpart: No healthy matching wallpaper was found. No files were changed.
fix.targetChanged: This folder changed after the scan. No files were changed. Scan again.
fix.unsafeFile: The missing filename points outside its wallpaper folder. No files were changed.
fix.mediaChanged: This folder no longer matches the scanned issue. It was not moved. Scan again.
fix.mediaAmbiguous: A project needs one image or MP4. No files were changed.
fix.unsafeDestination: The myprojects library is inside the source folder. Choose a separate library before resolving this wallpaper.
fix.sourceChanged: The source changed during extraction. The extracted copy was kept, and the source was not moved. Scan again.
